rationale: Both are polished, well structured catalogues that systematically cover audits, roadmaps and advisory across Data, Data Management, Automation and AI. Both stay M365-centric while extending to other platforms. A has stronger commercial packaging: service codes, a duration and fee model for each service, and a useful Data-for-AI readiness assessment. B better meets the prompt's explicit emphasis on cutting-edge technology. It flags frontier offerings and includes substantive modern services: data mesh and data fabric, intelligent process automation combining Document Intelligence and Copilot with human-in-the-loop, Copilot Studio agent design, and generative-AI solution advisory covering RAG versus fine-tuning, grounding, and evaluation and guardrail frameworks. B also adds practical items A lacks, such as cross-platform migration and automated retention design. Its upfront three engagement depths make the catalogue easy to navigate. A uses slightly dated naming (Power Virtual Agents). The difference is modest, but B's offerings show more insight into the current technology frontier the client wants to sell.
